# Exact-pinned reference lock file for the Windows portable build.
#
# This file records the exact package versions this repository was
# last verified against. It is a reference starting point, not the
# final word for any specific release: `build-windows-portable.yml`
# regenerates the *authoritative* lock for each release by running
# `pip freeze` on the actual Windows GitHub Actions runner right after
# installing, and includes that generated file in the release folder's
# BUILD_MANIFEST.txt -- because a version string alone does not
# guarantee an identical wheel was used on Windows vs. this reference.
#
# To refresh this reference file locally after a deliberate dependency
# upgrade:
#   pip install -r requirements-windows-build.txt --upgrade
#   pip freeze > requirements-windows-lock.txt
# (then remove any local-only/editable line for this project itself.)
